title: Find Duplicate Elements
description: Given `N` and an array of `N` integers, print all elements that appear more than once, in **ascending order**, separated by spaces. If there are no duplicates, print `None`.
instructions: Find all distinct values whose frequency is `>= 2`.
Sort them ascending and print space-separated, or print `None`.
hints: Count occurrences of each number using a frequency map.
Collect keys with count `> 1`, sort them ascending.
If the result list is empty, print `None`.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input().strip())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
